body:
This was added in #116187. The workaround suggested in #83267 still works and is still apparently the best way of handling the "format on save" feature for formatter plugins.

In case there's some limitation that makes the ideal solution impossible, for me as a plugin developer, the next best thing would be to have conditions for reliable use explicitly documented. For example, if this method is promised in documentation to work reliably if called at least 1 second apart, then in the plugin I can disable the button for modifying the script and then re-enable the button after 1 second passes.

If in the MRP python script I switch `changing.gd` to `changer.gd` and then spam the Change and Reload button, it sometimes works and sometimes causes the editor to crash. This would be to externally modify a `@tool` script and reload it from the `@tool` script itself, so I guess it might be a strange case that doesn't need to be handled, but it would be better if it at least failed more gracefully.

It sometimes gave me a few errors too:
```
  ERROR: modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:763 - Condition ' (ip + 7 + _pointer_size) > _code_size ' is true. Breaking..:
  ERROR: res://changer.gd:8 - Internal script error! Opcode: 0 (please report).
  ERROR: modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:3338 - Condition ' (ip + 8) > _code_size ' is true. Breaking..:
  ERROR: res://changer.gd:8 - Internal script error! Opcode: 81 (please report).
```
